summary: Twelve selected items form a coherent set anchored on the GPT-5.6 / ChatGPT Work launch, with distinct angles (livestream announce, product intro, developer desktop app, enterprise cost framing) plus competitive threads (Meta Muse Spark, Musk-on-Anthropic and the SpaceXAI compute-dependence context), Anthropic product and governance news, OpenAI personnel news, third-party distribution, and a research analysis. Each item carries a source URL and derived timestamp, coverage spans multiple labs, and no hard duplicates or fingerprint collisions were found. The multiple OpenAI-launch and Musk/Anthropic items are same-event-distinct-angle rather than redundant, so the set passes without replacements.
